primary.description: Deep Teal for primary actions, branding, and active states.

accent.description: Soft Blue for secondary actions and information highlights.

background.description: Off-white body background to reduce glare, pure white for content surfaces.

status.description: Status colors for stock levels (Green: In Stock, Amber: Low Stock/Expiring Soon, Red: Out of Stock/Expired).

surfaces.input: bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-md focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500/20 focus:border-teal-600

grids_and_layouts.pos_register: Grid layout: Left Panel (Categories) col-span-2, Center (Products) col-span-6, Right (Cart/Payment) col-span-4. Fixed height h-screen with internal scrolling to prevent page scroll.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard: High-density Mode B Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4. Top row: KPI summary cards (col-span-1). Middle row: Charts (col-span-2).
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Dense layout: use p-4 for cards, gap-4 for grids. Tighter spacing for tables (p-2 cells) to show more data.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-md with crisp hover states. Primary: bg-teal-600 text-white hover:bg-teal-700. Secondary: bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50.
components.tables: Shadcn UI Tables. Zebra striping or subtle border-b. Sticky headers. text-sm. Right-align numeric columns (currency).
components.forms: Left-aligned labels, bold tiny uppercase text. Shadcn UI Input, Select. Command Palette (Ctrl+K) for global search.
components.badges: For stock status and roles. Rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold.

motion_and_interactions.hover: Transition transform and colors. Buttons scale slightly active:scale-95.
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Fade in and slide up for panels and modals. Staggered list items in POS.
motion_and_interactions.toast: Use Sonner for toast notifications, located in top-right or bottom-right.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA / WCAG AA standards. Dark text on light backgrounds.
accessibility.focus: Clear focus rings: focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-teal-500 focus:ring-offset-1.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

image_urls.description: Bright, modern, clean, white pharmacy interior background.
Medicine bottle on white background, suitable for POS product tiles if images are needed.

instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js files not .tsx files, adapt imports and syntax accordingly.
Implement the UI using a 'Flat Solid' healthcare strategy—avoid glassmorphism and heavy drop shadows to keep the data clear and clinical.
For the POS Register, optimize for touch: large click targets, clear borders between products, sticky cart summary.
Use color purposefully: Red/Amber specifically for low stock or expiring lots (FEFO).
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on overlays/dropdowns.
Prioritize Recharts for dashboard charts (sales trend, category mix).
Add data-testid attributes to all form inputs, buttons, and critical UI elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Use the defined typography (Manrope/IBM Plex) to create a distinct brand feel.
Create depth with subtle 1px borders and targeted light shadows, not massive blurs.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions (opacity, transform, colors).
Do NOT center-align the main app container. Maintain left-aligned, structured data grids.
Use modern button styles (rounded-md or pill) with hover animations.
NEVER use emojis as icons. Use the designated icon library.
